skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the fundamental concepts and functions of marketing management, including strategic planning, market analysis, and marketing mix management.
Analyze market opportunities, select target markets, and develop marketing strategies.
Develop and implement marketing strategies and tools.
Work effectively in a team, support team members, and present clearly structured and persuasive presentations.
Take responsibility for personal and group work, and create a dynamic and friendly group environment.
Apply critical thinking to analyze marketing environments, customer behavior, and marketing resources.
Manage marketing projects, including planning, execution, evaluation, and adjustment.
Communicate effectively in both written and oral formats, including report writing and presentations.
Conduct marketing research and information management.
Understand and apply business strategies in marketing contexts.
